title: Northern Michigan Wildcats to host Roosevelt Lakers in GLIAC football matchup
text:
Northern Michigan Wildcats to host Roosevelt Lakers in GLIAC football matchup
The Northern Michigan Wildcats will host Roosevelt Lakers this Saturday in Marquette for a key conference football matchup. Quarterback Matt Stevens is coming off an impressive debut performance as both teams look to improve their standings within NCAA Division II competition.
The Northern Michigan football team will return home to face the Roosevelt Lakers in a Great Lakes Intercollegiate Athletic Conference game at the Superior Dome, with kickoff scheduled for 1 p.m. on Saturday, October 24.
Saturday's contest can be watched on FloCollege or heard on 100.3 The Point, with Casey Ford providing commentary. Fans are encouraged to follow @NMU_Football on Instagram and X for updates throughout the game.
Head coach Shane Janus said about quarterback Matt Stevens, "There were some really impressive things he [QB Matt Stevens] did escaping out of the pocket and extending plays with his feet. What excites me probably the most was the maturity and his progressions, which is high-level for a young guy. We feel like we have some momentum, and obviously he's going to take that into the Roosevelt game. It's a new week, so it's going to present some different challenges and the way they play defense." Stevens made his first career start last week against Michigan Tech, completing 25 of 38 passes for 319 yards and one touchdown while rushing for an additional 68 yards and another score without committing any turnovers.
In that previous outing, Northern Michigan posted season highs in points and total yardage with 553 offensive yards—its highest since September 2022—and set season marks in both rushing (234) and passing (319) yards. Running back Noah Dobert rushed for 110 yards with two touchdowns while Wilson Ptacek led receivers with seven catches for 82 yards and a touchdown.
Dobert has been named to the D2Football.com Elite 100 watchlist alongside linebacker Jax Hertel; both earned First-Team All-GLIAC honors last season. Dobert currently ranks second in conference rushing through seven games this year after setting school records last season with over 1,650 rushing yards and earning multiple awards including GLIAC Offensive Back of the Year. Hertel leads defensively after topping team tackles last year as well as recording significant tackles-for-loss stats.
Roosevelt enters Saturday’s matchup at 5-2 overall following wins over Chicago State, Quincy, Southwest Baptist, UW-Stout, and Wayne State but losses against Michigan Tech and Davenport during GLIAC play. The series between NMU and Roosevelt is tied at one win each; NMU won their most recent meeting last year by totaling a program-record 538 rushing yards en route to victory.
The Northern Michigan Wildcats men's football team competes in NCAA Division II as part of university athletics within Marquette under the Great Lakes Intercollegiate Athletic Conference, according to the official website.
